# KaTeX 0.19.1

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.1.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.19.1

License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Only the browser module, stylesheet, and WOFF2 fonts are included. The stylesheet's older WOFF/TTF fallback URLs were removed; all other library files are unchanged. No package installation or network request is needed to render notes.
